## Research

My research in **neural algorithmic reasoning** seeks to understand and develop algorithmic capabilities in machine learning. I study when neural networks learn algorithms and generalize across graph sizes and distributions. I combine theoretical analysis with algorithmic alignment to design learning methods for combinatorial optimization, motivated by applications in biology and chip design.
